reviews.comment: 3 lean composer subagents (analyst/author/reviewer) registered + wired; dedup/reuse + best-practice in prompts. Clean.

Grow from 3 broad subagents to per-kind (module/agent/flow/relationship) — reverses the 'start lean' decision #4. Exact decomposition (per-kind authors only ~4 vs per-kind at every stage ~12) to be pinned before the fix.

fix.comment: Grew to 12 per-kind subagents (analyst/author/reviewer × module/agent/flow/relationship); re-wired authoring agents (analyze→4 analysts, implement+fix→4 authors, review→4 reviewers). Install emits 12 subagents. 314 tests green.

reviews.comment: Per-kind fix correct (12 subagents, 314 green). Flow evaluation surfaced improvements (non-blocking, N195-scoped): #1 authoring agents don't drive tracker status (no lifecycle cmds / status-transition) so status-edges+kanban don't advance; #2 'test' validates load not function; #3 no target-harness opt-in; #4 created ids not recorded. Recommend follow-up tasks.

Subagent prompts too thin to author reliably — make them concrete: how each kind is created (create_* shapes/fields), the rules (custom: ids, locked tiers, baseline, handover semantics, single-token), worked examples. Pin approach: (A) inline / (B) shared conventions module / (C) MCP describe tool before fixing.

fix.comment: B+C: single-source composer-conventions.ts → MCP describe tool (C, all 12 subagents call it) + composer-authoring-conventions module (B, composed into 8 orchestrators). Also fixed stale 'default flow' desc. 315/315.

reviews.comment: Add a tiered reuse-first policy everywhere: search first; exact→reuse; minor change + unreferenced→edit in place; minor but referenced→variant or ask; wider rework→ask user; new only as last resort. Encode in COMPOSER_RULES (→ describe + module) + analyst/author prompts; analyst reports reference status.

fix.comment: Tiered reuse-first rule in COMPOSER_RULES (→ describe + module) + 12 subagents: analysts report reference status, authors apply edit-in-place/variant/ask/create, reviewers flag duplicates. 315/315.
